marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots increasing to northwest 20 late this
morning then diminishing to light near midnight. Wind becoming southeast 15
Thursday evening. Scattered flurries ending this afternoon. Fog patches
forming Thursday afternoon. Temperatures near minus 7. Freezing spray ending near midnight. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 this morning then
subsiding to 1 or less late overnight.<br/>
